visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt gently adjusts a white comforter over a woman sleeping in a pink long-sleeved shirt on a bed with yellow linens. (2) The man is at a white paneled door, gripping the silver handle and pressing his palm against the door frame with a strained, focused facial expression as he slowly closes it. (3) He tiptoes carefully across a light-colored wooden floor toward the bed. (4) In a brightly lit bathroom, the man uses his fingertips to slowly and cautiously lower a white toilet seat lid onto a bidet-equipped toilet. (5) In a kitchen, the man hugs a dark grey stainless steel refrigerator while slowly pushing the door shut with a concentrated look. (6) On the bed, the man shushes a small brown terrier dog with a finger to his lips, then gently pats its head. (7) The woman is now sitting up in bed, using a blue hair dryer that blows her long dark hair and the sleeping man's hair vigorously. (8) The woman uses a handheld purple and grey vacuum cleaner, moving the nozzle across the sleeping man's chest and head area. (9) She sits on the bed opening a large bag of 'Simply' brand chips, creating movement in the bag while a white dog watches closely. (10) The woman and three small dogs (brown, black, and white) sit on the bed with their heads tilted back and mouths open as if howling. (11) The man wakes up smiling and laughing while the woman continues to vacuum his torso; he playfully pushes her arm away.
